architectureBoundary.preV89: FORMAL_GENERAL and FORMAL_THOUSAND selected rows were combined and allocateAndBuildPlans() was called once against the single totalCapital.
architectureBoundary.postV89: FORMAL_GENERAL and FORMAL_THOUSAND are each independently passed to allocateAndBuildPlans(..., STRATEGY_POOL_CAPITAL=200000); Hybrid is a separate shadow-only 200000 pool.

storageAudit.daySchema: v8_trade_journal_days retains one row per scan_date and one total_capital field.
storageAudit.planSchema: v8_trade_journal_plans has no top-level strategy_pool field; full stock object including post-V8.9 strategyPool is stored only inside plan_json.
storageAudit.writer: recordTradeJournalDay(scanDate, stocks, totalCapital, ...) persists the concatenated Formal stocks list under the single day totalCapital.
storageAudit.postV89PatchAudit: V8.9.x/V8.10 scripts add strategyPool elsewhere but do not revise v8_trade_journal_days/plans schema or recordTradeJournalDay semantics.
storageAudit.runtimeCapitalInput: runAfterMarketScanCore derives totalCapital from stored config / V7_TOTAL_CAPITAL / default; V8.9 saveStockConfig uses STRATEGY_POOL_CAPITAL=200000, so the compatibility totalCapital remains a per-pool-sized value while Formal plan allocation is independently performed in two pools.
storageAudit.publicJournalReader: /api/journal does not SELECT plan_json and exposes no strategyPool, so current public/protected journal readback cannot reliably separate post-V8.9 plan rows by Formal pool.

semanticFinding.statement: After the V8.9 architecture boundary, a day-level total_capital=200000 cannot be used as the denominator for the concatenated FORMAL_GENERAL + FORMAL_THOUSAND plan set. Research must either compute each pool separately with 200000 or, for a consolidated Formal-strategy view, use the sum of both Formal ring-fenced pool capitals (400000) while keeping Hybrid shadow separate.
semanticFinding.preV89Receipts: Existing 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-21 Tier-A receipts predate the V8.9 deployment and are not invalidated by this finding.
semanticFinding.unknownRule: Post-V8.9 rows lacking positively exposed pool identity are denominator-UNKNOWN for pooled Tier-A metrics; do not infer pool from historical current code unless exact plan-time evidence is available.

adversarialFixtures.falsifies: Treating day.total_capital as a combined post-V8.9 Formal denominator.

adversarialFixtures.note: 85% remains valid only as the active General-pool deployment ratio, not as consolidated two-Formal-pool deployment.

adversarialFixtures.falsifies: Any pooled metric that can exceed 100% solely because the denominator still carries one pool's 200000.

impactOnResearch: Post-V8.9 deploymentRatioPct computed from combined journal plans / day.total_capital is not promotion-grade.
Post-V8.9 projectedHeatPct and riskyNameHHIOnTotalCapital have the same denominator-version risk when Formal pools are combined.

Within-deployed-capital concentration metrics that normalize only by summed planned deployment can remain algebraically computable, but pool aggregation still changes the estimand and must be labeled.
Gate/quota scarcity, plan reserve, intraday NO-BUY, and realized fills remain separate layers.

minimalEvidenceRepair.preferred: Expose immutable plan-time strategyPool/poolCapital (or read existing archived v9_strategy_pool_plans) with exact-date completeness and version/generation metadata.
minimalEvidenceRepair.acceptableResearchReader: A protected exact-date reader may expose existing plan_json.strategyPool plus pool capital and counts without adding new market-data calls or changing Formal behavior.
